internal_measurement.results: Release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit 6c8757c. Workspace tests, lint, formatting, documentation-reference, public-surface, release-manifest, and cargo-publish-workflow checks passed. The USI smoke transcript reached usiok and readyok. This release adds a bounded check-only df-pn mate-solver API and example probe; normal engine search does not call it. No local diagnostic is a formal strength gate or release strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine result is a release criterion or playing-strength claim for this API-only release.

known_limitations: The check-only df-pn mate solver is not wired into normal engine search or USI output.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
